identifier.value: Explosives and Illicit Substance Detection Systems

product.name: Explosives and Illicit Substance Detection Systems
product.description: Systems that detect trace vapors of explosives, illicit drugs, and harmful chemicals using vapor detection technology combined with mass spectrometry analysis.

identifier.value: Multi-Pressure Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometry (MION2) Instrument

product.name: Multi-Pressure Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometry (MION2) Instrument
product.description: An instrument that performs chemical ionization mass spectrometry at multiple pressures to analyze complex airborne chemical mixtures with high sensitivity and selectivity.

identifier.value: Non-Contact Explosives Trace Vapor Detection System

product.name: Non-Contact Explosives Trace Vapor Detection System
product.description: A system that detects explosive vapors and particulates without physical contact by sampling air gaps and analyzing samples via mass spectrometry.

identifier.value: Orbitrap Mass Spectrometry System with Mobility Capability

product.name: Orbitrap Mass Spectrometry System with Mobility Capability
product.description: A mobile Orbitrap mass spectrometry system capable of acquiring high-resolution chemical data while in motion for field and non-lab applications.
